impact: A strong debut validates AI model valuations and supports GOOGL (a backer) and MSFT; the fade from the open shows how much fresh supply ANT adds, which could drain flows from other AI names like NBIS and MU.
summary: Anthropic (ANT) opened on Nasdaq at $111.50, 34% above its $83 IPO price, with 108 million shares worth about $12B changing hands in the opening trade and a market value of roughly $2 trillion at that price. The pop faded through the session: shares traded around $94.50 (up about 14%) in the afternoon, with more than 640 million shares traded by midday, as the broader market sold off. The record IPO raised $81.3B.
title: Anthropic opens at $111.50, up 34% from IPO, near $2 trillion value
